criteria.no: Unsupported elaboration, weakening or redirection appears.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: Only authorized meaning and permitted linguistic or fixture-data normalization appear.

faithful.instructions: For the source duty selected by anchor.statement, is the meaning authorized by anchor.quote and state.intent preserved? Read ordinary conversational directives as requirements and allow normal paraphrase into formal obligation language. Do not treat that linguistic normalization as permission to add domain facts. Compare actors, conditions, restrictions, permitted alternatives and operational choices. A concrete test literal can instantiate the approved fixture-only policy; an added configuration rule or selected output surface needs source authority.

criteria.no: An essential condition has no defined observation or recorded decision mechanism.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: The requirement identifies a concrete compliance check.

observable.instructions: Is the requirement in anchor.statement testable by observing actions, outputs, state or an expressly identified approval record or decision mechanism? Ignore fidelity and number of duties. Concrete configurations and file operations have observable behavior. Undefined quality words, private names without definitions and approval with no record or mechanism do not establish a check.

criteria.no: No work area or applicability set is identifiable.
criteria.unclear: An area is named but its applicability cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: A reviewer can identify the work area where this anchor applies, including an explicit all-items set.

scoped.instructions: Do anchor.statement and anchor.scope identify the governed activity, component, artifact, or explicit global set, independent of whether the requirement itself is vague or otherwise defective?

criteria.no: Missing context of a listed kind determines its meaning or approval condition.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: Its meaning requires none of the disqualifying missing context.

self_contained.instructions: Can the duty in anchor.statement stand on its own with respect to vocabulary and approval evidence? Only undefined subjective qualities, unexplained private shorthand, unresolved referents and approval without a named record disqualify it. Standard technical terms and explicit literal fixture values are understandable. A record, rather than merely an approver, is needed for approval. Ignore the other rubric judgments.

criteria.no: It joins independently enforceable predicates requiring different behavior or policy.
criteria.unclear: The statement does not establish whether its clauses express one predicate or separate duties.
criteria.yes: The statement specifies one predicate, including a common predicate over several surfaces.

single_constraint.instructions: Evaluate whether anchor.statement governs one predicate. Repeating the same prohibition or outcome over terminal output, saved artifacts or other listed surfaces is one rule. A trigger restricts applicability rather than adding a separate duty. Different obligations such as formatting logs and retrying failures are independent even if the same service performs both. Ignore unused duties from the provenance quote.
